apis.name: Stripe
apis.note: The largest description of the six by schema count (about 9,000 types).

apis.name: GitHub REST
apis.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests, organizations. The api.github.com description.
apis.note: The largest by operation count. Operation ids are GitHub's own (`repos/delete`).

apis.name: Twilio
apis.description: Messaging and voice. The core Api v2010 description (Twilio publishes one file per product).

apis.name: OpenAI
apis.description: Models, assistants, files, batches. The published OpenAPI 3.1 description (YAML).

apis.name: Kubernetes (core/v1)
apis.description: Pods, services, namespaces. The OpenAPI v3 description of the core/v1 group at release v1.37.1.
apis.note: One API group of many; the cluster-wide aggregated description is far larger.

apis.name: Discord
apis.description: Channels, messages, guilds. Discord labels this description a preview of its v10 HTTP API.
